faqs.q: Can I delete specific pages only?

faqs.a: Ranges are inclusive and forgiving: “5-7” deletes pages 5, 6 and 7. You can mix singles and ranges: “1,3,5-8”. Out-of-range numbers show an error instead of guessing.

delete-pdf-pages.formula:
remaining pages = total pages − deleted pages
(ranges like 5-7 expand to 5, 6, 7 — each counted once)
howTo: Click “Choose PDF file” and select the PDF you want to trim.
Tap the page tiles you want to remove, or type a range like “1,3,5-8” and click “Apply”.
Check the selection count, then click “Delete pages”.
keyFacts: Pages are numbered from 1 in the tool, matching what you see in PDF readers.
A range like “5-8” expands to pages 5, 6, 7 and 8 — ranges are inclusive on both ends.
Duplicate entries are counted once: “3,3,5” deletes pages 3 and 5 only.
Pages are removed from the highest number downwards, so earlier page numbers never shift during deletion.
The downloaded PDF is rebuilt with only the kept pages, in their original order.
